segments.name: Commercial Banking
segments.description: Takes deposits and makes commercial and consumer loans to businesses and individuals.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as one reportable segment - Commercial Banking - based on how the CODM manages the business activities, which are described above.

revenueModel.text: Borrowers pay interest on loans and depositors are paid interest on their deposits.
revenueModel.evidence: We offer a wide variety of deposit, loan, and other financial services to small and middle-market businesses, venture capital and private equity firms, non-profit organizations, business owners, entrepreneurs, professionals and high-net worth individuals.
